findings_headline.reading: 'indistinguishable'/'l1<l0'/'l1>l0' are the mechanical ADR 0008 sign rule over ALL per-run medians each side (never 'equal'); ADR 0007 restricts what may be CLAIMED to |effect| >= the cell's bar (10x instrument p99 error). Sub-bar verdicts are recorded, flip between fresh runs by design, and are gated as information only — see findings[].finding.
